summary: EL-TEAM AS (org. no. 983 389 317) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sortland, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-05-28. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 43.210 (Elektrisk installasjonsarbeid); it has 91 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 239.4 m and net income was NOK 16.8 m. CEO: Mads Håkon Røkenes; board chair: Olaf Erling Prestløkken; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS.
